findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: explain_business_claim · Private data: inspect_knowledge_frontier, get_knowledge_graph_status, search_hiring_activity, list_sectors, summarize_credential_demand, evaluate_pathways, inspect_procurement_activity, assess_workforce_demand, resolve_citation, get_entity, explain_confidence, check_business_health, explain_business_claim, list_health_capabilities, update_business_record, get_generated_asset, start_health_action, report_health_action_complete, run_business_study_markdown · Public sink: get_community_economy, check_comparability, set_website_domain · Destructive: investigate_economic_question, check_business_health, list_health_capabilities, recheck_business_health, run_business_study, run_business_study_markdown.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: explain_business_claim · Private data: inspect_knowledge_frontier, get_knowledge_graph_status, search_hiring_activity, list_sectors, summarize_credential_demand, evaluate_pathways, inspect_procurement_activity, assess_workforce_demand, resolve_citation, get_entity, explain_confidence, check_business_health, explain_business_claim, list_health_capabilities, update_business_record, get_generated_asset, start_health_action, report_health_action_complete, run_business_study_markdown · Public sink: get_community_economy, check_comparability, set_website_domain · Destructive: investigate_economic_question, check_business_health, list_health_capabilities, recheck_business_health, run_business_study, run_business_study_markdown

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
